metadata.description: Skeleton mapping for Pokemon GO background assets and Team backgrounds.
metadata.notes: This is a starter file. Replace placeholder URLs with actual image links from authoritative sources (Pokemon GO Hub, PokeAPI where available, Pokemon GO asset repositories) and set 'released' flags appropriately. Keys: backgrounds, teams, pokemon.

instinct.name: Team Instinct
instinct.source: https://pogotrades.com or pokemon-go-hub (replace with exact source URL)

valor.name: Team Valor
valor.source: https://pogotrades.com or pokemon-go-hub (replace with exact source URL)

mystic.name: Team Mystic
mystic.source: https://pogotrades.com or pokemon-go-hub (replace with exact source URL)

usage.description: How to use this file in the app
points: 1. The app should load this JSON (e.g., fetch('/pokemon-trade-list/data/go-bg.json')) and use `backgrounds` for available team/background choices.
2. Each pokemon entry maps by a key (pokedex number or unique id). Under `forms.default.go_background` supply either null or the id of a background in `backgrounds`.
3. If `go_background_image` is provided it should be used directly behind the pokemon tile. If null and `go_background` references a background id, use the background's `images.background`.
4. `released` flags indicate whether to show that background option in the UI (only show when released === true).
5. Replace all placeholder URLs with the exact asset URLs. Prefer original Pokemon GO asset hosts or community mirrors that allow hotlinking.
